digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm review API / external live tests
propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking pass (deprecated v0.11.0, removed 2026-08-12) and mapped to review_plan() and review_code(), but two external live-test modules still called the removed function.

External live tests in test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py fail with AttributeError: module 'rebar.llm' has no attribute 'review_ticket' because these modules were not retargeted during the removal epic.

External tests are excluded from the standard Gerrit Verified gate, so the removal epic's pytest run did not exercise test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py, causing the regression to go undetected until live workflow_dispatch runs.

The old review_ticket() call signature and result schema (REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings) differ from review_plan() (no positional graph-target argument, returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT with no top-level findings), so retargeting required choosing the correct surviving API and adapting assertions.

Both external test modules were successfully retargeted to rebar.llm.review_code() (the surviving op returning REVIEW_RESULT), merged as d38eb1c7a1, and validated via live workflow_dispatch runs showing 3 LLM arms and langfuse tracing lane GREEN.
